subject.title: fix(security): add estimate-before-decode guard to base64 paths

question: After directly checking the Codex OAuth image-generation runtime contract, should this PR merge with its new per-image pre-decode limit behavior?
rationale: The repository policy makes direct sibling Codex source inspection a hard prerequisite for a Codex-related verdict; the available environment could not perform that inspection.

options.title: Verify the Codex contract, then merge
options.body: Inspect the exact Codex OAuth image-response path and merge if it confirms the current parser receives the expected base64 payloads and the configured limit is appropriate.

options.title: Pause for a narrower Codex-owner review
options.body: Hold the PR if the contract is unclear or if the route needs an explicit owner decision about truncation versus malformed-response failure.

recommendation.title: Verify the Codex contract, then merge
recommendation.body: Inspect the exact Codex OAuth image-response path and merge if it confirms the current parser receives the expected base64 payloads and the configured limit is appropriate.
